scope: Implementation of all eight findings from the UI/UX assessment
implemented: Collapsed region filters and advanced timeline tools; moved guide after the timeline
Explicit period selection; larger timeline targets and readable touch previews
Compact mobile/tablet header and fixed bottom navigation with 44px or larger targets
Short state introduction, compact metadata, expandable source notes and focused section navigation
Validated direct year entry on the time machine and map; optional slider and milestone exploration
Permanent approximate-centers/current-borders label, screen-space marker groups, group choices and fit-to-all opening view
Clearly separated atlas search, timeline filtering and searchable map region lists
Consistent war-record counts, explicit timeline navigation label and neutralized editorial phrasing

verification.releaseVerification: Verify the successful Pages run and live release.json after publication

limits: Browser viewport checks and touch emulation are not field research with recruited users
Map coordinates remain static approximate centers over current country boundaries
Battle counts describe ruler-attached records, not deduplicated historical events
